# NZ Document Assist

> NZ Document Assist Limited handles New Zealand documents going overseas from start to finish: apostille, authentication, ordering new BDM certificates, Notary Public appointments, translation and tracked courier. Clients tell us the document and the country; we confirm exactly what it needs, send one all-in quote (government fees and GST included) and handle every step through to delivery. Apostille all in from NZ$116. Based in Auckland, helping clients throughout New Zealand and overseas.

Key facts:
- Document specialist with 15 years' consular experience. Most refusals are caused by small mistakes (wrong certificate, wrong certification, apostille instead of authentication, e-apostille when paper is required); we check every document before it is lodged.
- Approved BDM Online organisation: we order New Zealand birth, marriage and other certificates directly, so clients do not need to be in New Zealand.
- One all-in price, confirmed in a free quote before any work starts. No separate government bills.
- Typical timeframe: about 3 weeks, or about 1 week with the urgent service for eligible documents. Countries that need an embassy step take longer.
- Free route check: we confirm whether a country needs an apostille or authentication at no charge.
- Contact: 022 100 3242 (+64 22 100 3242), help@nzdocumentassist.co.nz, or the form at https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/contact/

We are an independent company, not a government agency, law firm, Notary Public or licensed immigration adviser, and we do not give legal or immigration advice. Where a Notary Public or translator is needed, we arrange an independent provider and include their fee in the same all-in quote.

## Prices (NZ$, all in, incl. GST and government fees)

- Apostille: from NZ$116 (e-apostille by email). Original couriered back within NZ from NZ$148.
- NZ birth certificate ordered, apostilled and sent to the UK: from NZ$244.
- Authentication (e.g. UAE, Thailand, Malaysia, Qatar): from NZ$205. Countries needing an embassy step are quoted all in.
- Notarised document + apostille (power of attorney, passport copy, school, private or medical documents): quoted all in, including the notary's fee.
- Urgent service: + from NZ$169.
- New BDM certificate: + from NZ$50.
- Courier within NZ: from NZ$32. International delivery quoted.
- Translation, multi-step and complex cases: quoted all in.
- Full price list: https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/pricing/

## Services

- [Apostille NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-nz/): We check, lodge and deliver apostilles for New Zealand documents. All in from NZ$116.
- [DIA Apostille](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/dia-apostille-nz/): We prepare and lodge the application with the Department of Internal Affairs for you.
- [Apostille Auckland](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-auckland/): Auckland clients: document pickup, lodging and return, plus in-person help by appointment.
- [Document Authentication NZ](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/document-authentication-nz/): For countries outside the Hague Convention (UAE, Thailand, Malaysia, Qatar and others). We handle every step, including any embassy step. From NZ$205.
- [Notary + Apostille](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/notary-public-auckland-help/): We book an independent Notary Public, tell you what to bring, then handle the apostille and delivery. One all-in quote.
- [Translation](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/translation-coordination-nz/): We arrange an accepted translation and fit it into the right step.
- [Courier & Document Return](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/courier-document-return/): Tracked delivery back to you or straight to the overseas office.
- [Pricing](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/pricing/): All-in prices, government fees and GST included.
- [How It Works](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/how-it-works/): Tell us the document and country, get one all-in quote, we handle every step.
- [About](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/about/): Who we are and our 15 years of consular experience.
- [Contact](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/contact/): Free document check and quote. Phone 022 100 3242.

## Documents we handle

- [Birth certificate apostille](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-birth-certificate-nz/): We order the right certificate, apostille it and send it anywhere. To the UK from NZ$244.
- [Marriage certificate apostille](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-marriage-certificate-nz/): The document signed on the wedding day cannot be apostilled; we order the correct certificate.
- [Certificate of No Impediment](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/certificate-no-impediment-nz/): For New Zealanders marrying overseas. Allow about 4 weeks.
- [Criminal record / police clearance apostille](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-criminal-record-nz/): We request the record with your signed authority and get it apostilled.
- [Education documents](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-education-documents-nz/): Degrees, transcripts, NZQA and school records. We confirm whether a notary is needed first.
- [Power of attorney](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-power-of-attorney-nz/): Notary and apostille arranged together.
- [Divorce / dissolution papers](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/apostille-divorce-dissolution-nz/): New Zealand does not issue a "divorce certificate"; we confirm the right document and form.
- [Passport copy](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/certified-copy-passport-nz/): A JP-certified copy is refused for an apostille; we arrange the notary and apostille.
- [Croatian citizenship documents](https://nzdocumentassist.co.nz/croatian-citizenship-documents-nz/): NZ documents prepared for Croatian citizenship applications.
